POV: you take a wrong turn at Mango Bay and end up eating seafood on a rock above the water.

On The Rock Restaurant & Beach Bar is exactly what it sounds like. Tables perched on the rocks, waves below, cold drinks in hand. 4.3 stars across 470 reviews backs it up.

Find it at Hẻm 8 Đường Lê Thúc Nha, Phú Quốc. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
